name: Annihilus

abilityDetails.True Accuracy: Bu saldırılar Otomatik Blok ve Kaçış (Evade) etkilerini yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Stifle: Saldırı Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Aptitude: Fury, Armor Up ve Precision etkilerinin gücünü artırır.
abilityDetails.Block Penetration: Saldırılar, rakibin blok yeterliliğinin belirli bir kısmını yok sayar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Kozmik asasını kaldırmayan şampiyon kullanma. Asayı nötralize etmek durdurulamazlığını ve güç çekme immünitesini kaldırır. Nötralize dışında durdurulamaz süresini kısaltan şampiyonlar da işe yarar.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Cosmic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Tremble Before Me
While his Opponent's back is near a wall, Annihilus Gains a Passive Aptitude, increasing the Potency of all Fury, Armor Up, and Precision Buffs by [9.88 - 100]%.
While Annihlus' back is near a wall he gains a Passive Block Penetration Buff, allowing all attacks to ignore [25 - 100]% of the Opponents Block Proficiency.
immunityDetails:
• Yakma Bağışıklığı 🔥
• Ani Soğuk Bağışıklığı 🧊
• Güç Emme/Yakma Bağışıklığı 🔋

abilitySections.title: Cosmic Control Rod - Buff
content: Annihilus gains the Cosmic Control Rod at the Start of the Fight.
Whenever the opponent activates a Nullify, Fateseal, or Stagger ability, The effect is Purified and the Cosmic Control Rod is removed for 10 seconds.
Immune to Incinerate, Frostbite, Coldsnap, Power Drain, Power Steal, Power Burn, Power Lock, and Enervate.
While Taunted, gain a True Accuracy Buff, an Unblockable Buff, and an Unstoppable Buff.

abilitySections.title: Obliterating Strikes
content: While the Cosmic Control Rod is active, all attacks have a 60% chance to be an Obliterating Strike.
Obliterating Strikes are not affected by Ability Accuracy reduction.
Obliterating Strikes have a 100% chance to inflict Armor Break, reducing Armor Rating by [250] for 5 seconds.
Annihilus Purifies incoming Stun Debuffs while launching Obliterating Strikes.

abilitySections.title: Stifle (Max 12)
content: Whenever Annihilus would inflict an Armor Break, he also has a 100% chance to inflict Stifle, reducing Offensive Combat Power Rate by 9% for 4 seconds.
While the Opponent is Stifled, Annihilus' first Medium Attack in a combo removes 1 Stifle and generates 1 Fury Buff, increasing Attack Rating by [1,120.2] for 0.9 seconds.
If the Opponent Dashes Back while Stifled, Annihilus removes 1 Stifle and gains 1 Unstoppable Buff lasting 1.1 seconds.

abilitySections.title: IT'S MIIIIINE--!
content: When the Cosmic Control Rod is Removed, Annihlus gains 3 Fury Buffs, each increasing Attack Rating by [1,493.6] for 10 seconds

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit Refreshes all personal Stifle Debuffs on the Opponent, and the Final Hit pauses the duration of all Stifle Debuffs for 6 seconds.
Any Paused Stifles on the Opponent increase Annihilus' Offensive Combat Power Rate by 9%

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: When Activating this Special, Annihilus consumes every Stifle on the Opponent, each generating 1 Fury increasing Attack Rating by [1,120.2] for 18 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Annihilus inflicts the Opponent with 10 Stifle Debuffs, each reducing Offensive Combat Power Rate by 9% for 4 seconds.
Until the Opponent has 0 Stifles remaining, the duration of Stifle Debuffs is increased by 125%
